text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. As I took my 
food from the buffet and looked for a 
seat, I saw Mejiro Ryan tilting her head 
in confusion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, what should I do? Did I eat a bit 
too much...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I decided today would be a 
rest day for my muscles, I accidentally 
ate my usual portion of food without 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Carbohydrates are an essential energy 
source. So I eat a lot of them on days I 
work out, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Taking too much on a rest day like today 
actually has the opposite effect...!"
choice_data_list:
If you took it yourself, you have to eat 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Trainer, don't you need to eat 
your own meal too...?
choice_data_list: This much will be totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, it is NOT fine! A disturbance in 
nutrition is a disturbance in muscle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about a little strength training after 
our meal? Don't worry, I'll be keeping an 
eye on you!

Afterward, I worked out alongside Mejiro 
Ryan, who had stopped eating at 80% full.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. Y-You're right... Leaving leftovers 
would be rude to the ingredients, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. I served this portion myself, so 
I'm going to make sure I eat every last 
bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, with heartfelt thanks—bon 
appétit!

Mejiro Ryan ate her fill on her rest day. 
She seemed quite satisfied, but it appears 
she gained some weight as a result.
